messages:
anya: short kick-off: need a durable plan for per-customer precision overrides + safe runtime fallbacks. tradeoffs and action items.
mike_k: choice: bundle profile with model vs central override service. bundle = reproducible; central = fast fixes.
priya: agree. bundle should be default; central overrides allowed but signed, versioned, and auditable.
sam: runtime needs ETag caching and a pinned fallback to the model-bundled profile when fetch fails. avoid thundering herd.
zach: schema idea: minimal core + optional extended. core: profile_version, allowed_bitpaths, fallback_order, max_quality_delta, lite_blob_ref.
priya: include eval_promptset_id and calibration_holdouts for reproducibility and QA.
anya: merge priority: customer_override -> model_default -> global_default. make this explicit in runtime docs.
runtime-bot: telemetry stub updated: deg_score_window, top_k_disagree, token_confidence_p95 added to specs.
sam: gating: runtime emits weighted signal for automated rollback. zach suggested score = 0.6*deg + 0.3*top_k + 0.1*perplexity. rollback if score > 0.05 for 10m.
ops-bot: will add evict CLI: `ops-bot evict-profile --node id --profile id --confirm`.
mike_k: API sketch: GET /v1/profiles/{org}/{model} with ETag, 304 if unchanged; POST overrides with signed payload + X-Signature header. rate-limited.
priya: offline preflight: any override that enables a new bitpath or changes quality threshold > 0.01 must run offline sim on stored traces before canary.
zach: add safety_backstop flag in profile to force safe variant when telemetry unreadable.
anya: action items: (1) Priya publish minimal+extended schema (2) Mike proto + auth + audit (3) Sam runtime ETag + merge + telemetry hooks (4) Zach rollback playbook + defaults (5) Ops-bot eviction CLI. target: RFC follow-up in 4 business days.
